extension.summary: 落ち着いたサイバーパンク調のスキン
extension.description: A netrunner look in calm cyan with pink accents: cut corners, glitch titles and big artwork, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.
Ein Netrunner-Look in ruhigem Cyan mit pinken Akzenten: abgeschnittene Ecken, Glitch-Titel und große Bilder, mit Online-Daten zu Filmen und Serien von TMDb Helper.
Un look de netrunner en cyan apaisé avec des touches de rose : coins coupés, titres glitch et grandes illustrations, avec les données en ligne des films et séries de TMDb Helper.
Un aspecto de netrunner en un cian sereno con acentos rosas: esquinas cortadas, títulos con efecto glitch e imágenes grandes, con datos en línea de películas y series de TMDb Helper.
Un look da netrunner in un ciano calmo con accenti rosa: angoli tagliati, titoli glitch e grandi immagini, con dati online su film e serie TV da TMDb Helper.
Um visual de netrunner em ciano suave com detalhes em rosa: cantos cortados, títulos com efeito glitch e imagens grandes, com dados online de filmes e séries do TMDb Helper.
Wygląd netrunnera w spokojnym cyjanie z różowymi akcentami: ścięte rogi, tytuły z efektem glitch i duże grafiki, z danymi online o filmach i serialach z TMDb Helper.
落ち着いたシアンにピンクのアクセントを効かせた、ネットランナー風の外観です。角を落としたカット、グリッチ風のタイトル、大きなアートワークを備え、TMDb Helperによるムービーとテレビ番組のオンライン情報も表示します。
extension.news: 0.4.90 - Every card has the cut corners now, also without the focus: a faint cyan frame around each poster, the focus keeps the bright frame and the glow.[CR]Nightcity now speaks German, French, Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish and Japanese. For Japanese choose the font Arial under Settings, Interface, Skin, Fonts: it is Kodi's own font with Japanese letters.[CR]The buttons of an info page have room for every language: the last one was cut off in German.[CR]0.4.89 - The subtitle delay can be set again in the player: its dialog showed a large coloured box and left and right did nothing.[CR]0.4.88 - Nightcity can now run next to the new Confuse skin: switching skins starts the service of the new skin and keeps the settings of each.[CR]0.4.87 - Title pages have the same room above and below the logo, and the poster now ends level with the buttons.[CR]The player controls wrap around: left of the first one goes to the last one and back, also in the music player.[CR]Moving between the left and right controls of the player always lands on the next control, no longer on the one you used last there.[CR]0.4.86 - The spotlight follows the cursor: on a card in a row of the home, movies, shows and music pages it shows that title, and it fades back to its own when you return, with the timer starting anew.[CR]Ratings now show everywhere by default, on a card after you stand on it for a moment. The new setting Ratings only on title pages saves requests to TMDb.[CR]The position bar is also in the music library, on albums, artists and genres. Its cursor glides from group to group, and the column beside it makes room only while the bar has the focus.[CR]Opening an episode no longer lands on the wrong season and episode when another show's page was open before, and tabs and episodes are always in order.[CR]There is more room between the logo and the tags in the spotlight.[CR]0.4.85 - All movies and all shows have a position bar: a faint rail at the far right shows where the grid stands, Right from the menu next to the grid moves onto it and it names the letter, year, month or rating there. Up and Down move one group and the first title comes up on the top row, OK goes there, Back returns to the card you came from.[CR]The info page has a description button in its row, biography on a person's page, that opens the whole text, and Up from the row leaves the page at once. The text itself no longer takes the focus.[CR]Unwatched shows get the dog-ear, and the dog-ear on the spotlight's poster belongs to its own title instead of whatever has the focus.[CR]The startup screen stays up a second shorter.[CR]0.4.84 - An episode started from its info page plays on into the next ones when Kodi's setting to play the next video automatically is on for episodes. In an episode's last 30 seconds, while another one follows, a next episode button comes up over the video with the cursor on it: OK plays the next episode at once, Back hides the button.[CR]0.4.83 - A movie's info page shows its budget and box office. The player's controls have an info button left of subtitles that opens the page of what plays. On the page of the movie or episode that plays, one button leads back to the video instead of buttons that started it again. The trailer button comes after resume and from start.[CR]0.4.82 - Back from the info page of a spotlight returns to its info button; before, no button showed the cursor until you pressed down. Holding Back while browsing cast and crew from the player lands on the player's play or resume button. A longer plot shows three dots at its end instead of the hint "OK read more" next to the buttons. The mark of unwatched titles is in the focus colour.[CR]0.4.81 - A trailer button sits next to play on a movie's info page, also on TMDb pages: the trailer plays full screen over the page, Back returns to the button, and without the YouTube add-on the button offers to install it. Holding Back on an info page goes back to where you started browsing cast and crew: the movie or episode page, or the player's cast row. Focused buttons, pills and rows glow like the focused cards, the cards glow stronger, and no glow is cut at the edge of a list; the glow setting is gone, it is always on. The mark of unwatched titles is bigger. The current episode in an episode list and the playing card in the music queue have a line above their picture. The quick menu has new power icons, with exit Kodi under power off and restart Kodi under reboot. Video calibration in the display settings now opens. On the info page of the movie that plays, resume and from start are gone, since they started it from the beginning: back to the video is the way. The hint to read the whole plot no longer covers the buttons. Needs TMDb Helper 1:6.20.2-1 from the twiebe repository.[CR]0.4.80 - The player's seek line is cleaner: the played part sits on the line instead of under it, the position is a cyan block over and under the line, and the chapter marks stand out above and below it in the line's own colour. Notifications have a pink heading again, yellow for warnings and errors. Info pages, TMDb pages and music info pages show an up arrow with Back at the top, like the hints in the player, since Up from the top leaves the page.[CR]0.4.79 - The text viewer that shows a whole plot closes with OK, Left or Right, and with Up on its first page; Up and Down page through a longer text, and the first key in it no longer gets lost. The chapter marks on the player's seek line are drawn in the line's own dimmed blue.[CR]0.4.78 - Playing videos no longer flash black or drop their sound every few seconds while a cast and crew page or Home is open over them. The weather sits next to the clock wherever the clock shows at the top right: in the settings, the player and the info pages. The plot on an info page no longer scrolls by itself: Up from the buttons moves onto it, OK opens the whole text in a viewer, and a hint shows when it is longer than its box; a page without a plot says so. In the player the plot is cut off instead of scrolling. After a cast and crew page opened from the player, Up from the cast row reaches the chapter row again, and an Up pressed right after the return is no longer pulled back to the cast list.[CR]0.4.77 - The music player's buttons come in the same order as the video player's: previous, play or pause, stop, next. With the quick menu shown, the top line dims as well, only the menu icon stays bright, and the page stays dimmed but visible after Back from the weather. Notifications have a white heading, yellow only for warnings and errors, a dimmed text under it, and thin outline icons: a circle for info, a triangle for a warning, an octagon for an error.[CR]0.4.76 - Every row on the home, movies, shows and music pages is numbered in pink before its title, 01 for the first row shown; hidden rows take no number. The genre tabs are as large as the row titles. In the music queue the playing track keeps its mark while the cursor moves: a dimmed blue bar in a track list, a line under the title on the cards. Right on the last music spotlight button moves on to the next album again, and the music queue has no progress line any more. After Back from a title page the cast and crew tabs switch on focus again.[CR]0.4.75 - The chevrons after the spotlight buttons sit at the usual gap after the last button.[CR]0.4.74 - Colours follow one guide: white for content, cyan for the cursor, a dimmed blue for state and hints, pink for the line above titles, dialog headings and the numbering in the settings and on the system page, yellow only for warnings. Notifications show an icon, and only warnings and errors have a yellow heading. Rating stars are grey, the mouse pointer is cyan. After the spotlight buttons three small chevrons, each a step darker, show that Right moves on to the next title.[CR]0.4.73 - The arrow after the spotlight buttons is a slim drawn chevron instead of a > sign.[CR]0.4.72 - A dim arrow right of the spotlight buttons, as tall as they are, shows that Right moves on to the next title.[CR]0.4.71 - The clock is white everywhere: on Home with the weather beside it, in the quick menu, on the startup screen and in the top line of the other windows.[CR]0.4.70 - During playback the title and plot of a movie or episode show its ratings, following the Ratings settings; an episode shows its own ratings, not the show's. The music player shows your own rating and the song and album ratings when there are any. The title and plot during playback have more room: the plot shows five lines before it scrolls.[CR]0.4.69 - Ratings have their own settings category: a switch per source, IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes critics on by default, and by default only the ratings TMDb Helper fetched for exactly that title, never the library's own. The spotlight keeps a title's ratings once they are fetched, also after the focus leaves or the spotlight comes back to it; a further setting fetches them without focus. On an episode page the ratings follow the focused episode. Ends at looks like the runtime next to it. Pink is now kept for the line above the titles: the shown tab, the selected value, counters, separators and clocks use a dark blue.[CR]0.4.68 - Switching between the home and movies pages keeps the spotlight on its title, and a new title in the spotlight crossfades its logo, poster and backdrop. Movie and episode pages and the spotlight show when playback would end, counted from the resume point, or the player's own end time for the title that is playing. They show every rating TMDb Helper has: IMDb with its Top 250 rank, TMDb, Rotten Tomatoes critics and audience, Metacritic, Trakt, Letterboxd and MDbList, or the library rating without it. Movie pages show resolution, HDR or SDR and the audio track too, and audio reads like DD+ 5.1; the info key during playback names them the same way. Playing music opens the player screen, and Back returns to where it started. The top line shows what plays and opens the player screen. The queue opens on the playing track, which carries a progress line, and a queue from one album is a plain track list. The tab underline fits the width of its text. On CoreELEC and LibreELEC the settings page links their settings add-on, and settings entries that showed no text show it again.[CR]0.4.67 - First music support: a Music page on Home with an album spotlight and rows, album and artist pages, the music library, a player screen and a music OSD with the queue. When the player controls close, the poster, title and plot go first and the controls follow. The shown tab is marked by a pink line under it instead of a pink triangle in front. The selected value in a list is marked by a slim pink bar at the left edge. Header lines separate their parts with a pink dot.[CR]0.4.66 - Back in the quick menu or on its icon closes the menu and returns to where you came from, also on the settings page. On a switch between home and movies the spotlight shows the new title at once: its logo no longer crossfades and the backdrop fades in with the page. The arrows after the genre in the spotlight are gone.[CR]0.4.65 - Switching between the home, movies and shows pages moves the spotlight on to the next title, so the two pages never show the same one after a switch. An episode page opened on a freshly started or slow box selects the right episode instead of the first one. Opening another info page after the title menu of a TMDb title no longer crashes Kodi.[CR]0.4.64 - On the home pages the held Home key, the S key and the power key move the cursor to the quick menu icon, which shows the quick menu; the same key again takes the cursor back. The player controls no longer hide by themselves while the cursor is in the chapter row, the cast row or anything below the controls. A subtitle, audio or video panel no longer stays on screen over the chapter row or the cast row.[CR]0.4.63 - With the cursor on the quick menu icon the quick menu is already shown: Down or OK enters it, Up from its top and Back return to the icon, Left and Right leave it. The player controls no longer hide by themselves while the cursor is in the subtitle, audio or video panel. When the player controls open, the controls appear first and the poster, title and plot follow a moment later.[CR]0.4.62 - The weather tile in the quick menu opens a weather page with the current conditions and the forecast for the next days. The player controls hide by themselves a while after the last key press, 8 seconds by default and 3 to 30 seconds in the new Player settings, and stay while the video is paused. The plot under the title in the player can be switched off.[CR]0.4.61 - The quick menu icon is a plain hamburger. Settings live in one place: the quick menu has a single Settings link to the settings page, which left the top menu and shows a System section with the machine facts and a Settings section with the settings groups.[CR]0.4.60 - On the way back in a cast and crew chain the page no longer shows the focus on its buttons for a second before it jumps to the person: the focus appears on the person once the list is in. During playback the cast row comes back at once, without the chapter row in between.[CR]0.4.59 - Back in a cast and crew chain returns to the person, film or show it was left from, on the same tab, instead of the top of the page. Up from a person opened during playback returns to the cast row on that person, not to the chapter row. An episode page reopened on the way back shows its own show again: the season tabs no longer list every show.[CR]0.4.58 - Down from above skips a row of tabs and lands on its content, Up reaches the tabs: genre rows, cast and crew, search results. Cast and crew tabs switch as soon as the cursor is on them, no OK needed. Episode info pages show resolution, HDR or SDR and the audio track. The skin settings pick the colour scheme. New add-on icon.[CR]0.4.57 - The skin settings open on the main menu, which now comes first and holds the glow switch under Effects. The Effects category and the separate Home pages entry in the settings are gone, Skin leads to the same page.[CR]0.4.56 - Up and Down on the number pad (PIN and number entry) keep the column, like on the keyboard.[CR]0.4.55 - The - and + of a setting with a value range drop their boxes and the pink: the selected sign sits on a small dark chip. The slider knob turns light instead of pink while it moves.[CR]0.4.54 - Down from Play on an episode lands on the episodes, past the season tabs; up from the episodes reaches them.[CR]0.4.53 - The quick menu links (Settings, System, Files) also work over an info page or a TMDb Helper chain: they close it first. The chapter cards show the start time once, under the picture.[CR]0.4.52 - The spotlight fades in on every switch between home and movies, also when both show the same movie. The chapter row shows Kodi's own chapter pictures in full cards when the Jellyfin server has none, instead of short cards without a picture.[CR]0.4.51 - The episode number stands before the title under the picture, where bright pictures no longer hide it. The top menu wraps around: left on home reaches the quick menu icon, right on it home again. A held Home key opens the quick menu also on remotes whose Home key Kodi knows as browser_home or home. The quick menu links the file manager (Files).[CR]0.4.50 - Up and Down on the keyboard keep the column: Down from e lands on d, not on the key that had the focus last in that row.[CR]0.4.49 - First public release. A calm cyberpunk skin for Kodi 21 with configurable home, movies and shows pages, info pages that walk top down, endless cast and crew navigation through TMDb Helper, a search page, a quick menu with clock, weather and power, and a player with track panels, chapter row and cast row.
